caveats: Cachegrind Dr/Dw are instrumented data-reference counts; they are not native hardware loads/stores. Read-modify-write counts only as a read and REP iterations count separately.
Cache and branch misses are simulations, not measured native CPU hardware counters.
Instruction/data/branch event counts have no wall-time units and do not establish native speedup. Native results are separately measured without a profiler.
Function costs are self counts across all inlined source locations; compiler extraction/inlining changes their scope, so only whole-program counts are compared.
compiled_event_comparison.method: Same complete native workload arguments/inputs, optimized symbol binaries without profiling feature, one Rayon thread on CPU2, fixed Valgrind tool and I1/D1/LL geometry. Whole-program event counts compare equal scope; individual hot functions expose changed inlining boundaries.

baseline.function_scope: Function self-cost, including code inlined into that function, excluding non-inlined callees. Original occupancy was inlined into compute_from_center; final occupied_volumes is separately emitted. Individual function costs therefore have different scopes and are not used as the speedup comparison.

completion_audit.admission: Both candidate ceilings, realistic savings and eliminated work were recorded before production implementation in OPTIMIZATION.md. Candidate 1 was frozen before Candidate 2.
completion_audit.baseline: The original September 16 binary, source snapshots, outputs and input manifest remain frozen. Scientific comparisons use original outputs at matching thread settings.
completion_audit.engineering: 264 Rust tests, five release kernel differential tests, 49 Python tests, Clippy with warnings denied, strict rustdoc, formatting and Study 011 verification pass. The doctest command also passes (zero examples). Logs are under verification_sep19.
completion_audit.evidence: The summary and hash-verified archive retain frozen source, probes, counters, oracles, measurements and verification logs, including the initial noisy series and paired follow-ups.
completion_audit.failed_experiments: Both production candidates pass. No failed production experiment remains. Grid caching was rejected before implementation because its 1.035x ceiling is below the requested impact.
completion_audit.fine_granularity: Point/atom checks, strict early exits, repeated arithmetic, transformations/radii, allocations, branches and memory references are quantified in the operation, early-exit, diagnostic and Cachegrind JSON reports. Hardware perf is unavailable; instrumented references and simulated misses are explicitly labeled.
completion_audit.memory: Native RSS is essentially unchanged; the largest sequential median increase is 286,720 bytes. Scratch capacity is at most 576 bytes with zero growth in the corpus. Requested allocation traffic rises 0.274%, with essentially unchanged peak live requested heap.
completion_audit.numeric_outputs: Complete workload JSON, v1 records and database artifacts match. All 47 v2 records and 227 unrounded conformer rows match at both thread settings. Four complete million-value f32 prediction vectors match the original bytes.
completion_audit.occupancy_semantics: Integration grid, radii, precision and point order are unchanged. The locked glam f32 sum grouping and strict row rejection were reviewed. Five optimized kernel tests compare all volume fields with the independent old loop, including 56 real conformers. The production shadow matches all 462,240,000 points and first-hit atoms.
completion_audit.regression_gate: The initial parse and six-thread prediction slowdowns remain in the evidence. Follow-ups of 21 alternating pairs give candidate/control ratios 1.01249 (MAD 0.02072) and 0.99179 (MAD 0.06948), respectively. No meaningful repeatable regression remains.
completion_audit.screening_semantics: Parser, donor, axis, configuration, frame and atom validation and conformer summation order were reviewed. All later frames are still checked after an acceptance witness; the original degeneracy fallback remains. All 70 frozen CLI cases match at one and six threads.
completion_audit.source_review: Independent review found no material scientific or error mismatch. All 51 Cargo/Rust/test/example hashes match the accepted source identity. Numeric and wording issues found in report review were corrected.

manifest.comparison: Exact stdout bytes, stderr bytes, and process exit status; no normalization or tolerance.

full_prediction_audit.method: Correctness-only full-vector comparison: all 1000000 native-endian f32 predictions exported, compared byte for byte and SHA256 checked; no performance timings. Diagnostic binaries actually enable profiling Session and TrackingAllocator.

native_method: Seven measured warm-cache process launches after one warmup, exact-child wait4, process startup and regular-file output included. No builds or profilers overlap native series.

conformers_56.method: Sum each orientation first-hit histogram separately; indices below atoms-1 are strict early exits, index atoms-1 is a last-atom hit, final bin is a miss. Weighted histogram reproduces observed original predicate checks exactly.

descriptors_10000.method: Sum each orientation first-hit histogram separately; indices below atoms-1 are strict early exits, index atoms-1 is a last-atom hit, final bin is a miss. Weighted histogram reproduces observed original predicate checks exactly.

runs/candidate1_db_t6_paired.protocol: Correctness-checked native follow-up for observed six-thread variance; one warmup per binary, then 21 paired iterations with alternating A/B order; same frozen database workload; no overlapping processes.

runs/candidate2_parse_t1_paired.order: AB for even pairs, BA for odd pairs; no samples excluded

runs/candidate2_predict_db_t6_paired.order: AB for even pairs, BA for odd pairs; no samples excluded

All frozen fixture points are checked, but this chemistry sample does not exhaust supported configurations or nonfinite arithmetic.

derived_logical_scalar_input_demands.definition: Original distance needs point XYZ, atom XYZ and squared radius (7).
